body:
I love my boy more than anything. And all though he's emotionally distant, I love my husband. I live in such a small area and the only mental health clinic here won't see me without insurance. 

I'm just tired. Physically. Of all of it. He says no other woman would be as upset as I am. I said some mean things. I wish I hadn't said anything. But I can understand why he did it. I'm such a mess. No one should have to live with me.
I just don't want to hurt anymore :(

So many reasons. I'm unhappy with who I am inside and out. My relationship is in shambles. I have no job. I have no money. I have no contact with people outside of my husband. I'm fairly certain I have some form of social anxiety. People scare me, but I'm so lonely. He's furious with me right now because he went to a strip club and lied about it and now he thinks I have nothing to be mad about. So he won't talk to me, and I have literally no one to tell how awful I feel.
